fields.quoted_span:
A landlord, or
agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which
exceeds $50.
fields.note: The $50 cap, the $500/$750/$1,000 penalties, the Special Civil Part enforcement, remittance to the applicant, the CPI adjustment and the rulemaking all match the text. The document has the State Treasurer determine the adjustment amount, which the summary omits. This is a minor point.

fields.quoted_span:
up to $500 for a
first offense, up to $750 for a second offense, and up to $1,000 for each
subsequent offense
fields.note: The $50 cap and the penalty tiers match the document. The overcharge is remitted to the applicant. The January 1, 2027 start of CPI adjustment follows from the enactment date (January 20, 2026) and the 'January 1 of the year next following enactment' language.

fields.quoted_span:
This act shall take effect on the first day of the
fourth month next following the date of enactment
fields.note: Approved January 20, 2026, so the fourth month following is May, and the effective date is 2026-05-01.
